en.headline: Lai Ka-ying sends Mid-Autumn wishes from Tiangong space station
en.dek: Hong Kong’s first astronaut said looking at the moon and the Earth from space made her miss family and friends even more, and wished residents a happy and prosperous life.
body: Hong Kong payload specialist Lai Ka-ying, currently on the Shenzhou-23 mission aboard China’s Tiangong space station, sent Mid-Autumn Festival greetings to residents on Friday.

In a recorded message, Lai said it was her first time spending the festival in space. Looking at the moon and the lights of Earth from Tiangong made her miss her family and friends in Hong Kong more than ever, she said.

She thanked the public for letters, drawings and messages received after the Tiangong Classroom session with Hong Kong and Macau students, and encouraged continued interest in the country’s space programme. Lai and her crewmates Zhu Yangzhu and Zhang Zhiyuan also wished people across the country good health and happy families.

zh.headline: 黎家盈從天宮送中秋祝福 望明月更想念香港親友
zh.dek: 首位港產航天員表示首次在太空度過中秋，從天宮望明月、俯瞰地球萬家燈火，對家人和朋友更加想念。
body: 正在神舟二十三號任務中於天宮空間站工作的香港載荷專家黎家盈，周五向香港市民送上中秋祝福。
黎家盈在短片中表示，這是她首次在浩瀚太空度過充滿溫情的中秋節。每逢佳節倍思親，當她從天宮望明月、俯瞰地球家園的萬家燈火，心中對香港的家人和朋友更加想念。
她感謝市民在天宮課堂後送來的家書、畫作和祝福，並希望公眾繼續參與相關主題活動，深入了解國家航天成就。黎家盈亦聯同乘組指令長朱楊柱及航天員張志遠，祝願全國人民身體健康、闔家幸福，港澳市民安居樂業、生活美滿。
